entities.summary: Christian, a notable figure in the history of Ethiopia, associated with Zagwe and Solomonic Dynasties (1529–1543). Preceded by Ethiopian–Adal Wars and Battle Wayna Daga 1543. Their legacy influenced Gondar and Fasilides' Castles.
